title: Traveler's explanation resolves an apparent place conflict

modifications: Subject first names Laredo, then explains he crossed near Hidalgo and was picked up in Laredo; the officer records the clarification. The apparent conflict is resolved in the narrative.

narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On June 4, 2023, at approximately 1410 hours, Border Patrol Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] was conducting roving patrol duties on Interstate 75 near Monroe, Michigan. Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] observed a vehicle travelling northbound and conducted a vehicle stop with the assistance of Michigan State Police. Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] identified himself as a Border Patrol Agent and questioned the passenger, later identified as the subject, as to his citizenship. The subject stated that he is a citizen and national of Mexico and presented a Mexican voter identification card. The subject stated that he did not have any immigration documents allowing him to be in or remain in the United States legally. Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] placed the subject under arrest at approximately 1425 hours and transported him to the [REDACTED (b)(7)(E)] Border Patrol Station for processing.

ENTRY:
The subject stated that he entered the United States on or about March 10, 2018, by wading across the Rio Grande, and that he was not inspected or admitted by an immigration officer. The subject stated that he then travelled by car to San Antonio, Texas, and later by bus to Toledo, Ohio, where he has lived since 2019.
When first asked, the subject said he crossed at Laredo, Texas. When asked again, the subject explained that he crossed the river near Hidalgo, Texas, and that Laredo is where a driver picked him up the next day. Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] recorded the place of entry as near Hidalgo, Texas, based on this explanation.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
The subject was processed for a Notice to Appear and was served with a Warrant of Arrest. The subject was transferred to Immigration and Customs Enforcement custody pending removal proceedings.
